claim:
Assume full AC. The stable isometry class of the Seifert quadratic enhancement and its Arf value are independent of the spanning surface and integral symplectic basis of an oriented knot $K$. Stable isometry means isometry after orthogonally adjoining finitely many hyperbolic planes $q_H(s,t)=st$ on either side. Under the convention $\Delta_K(t)=
abla_K(t^{1/2}-t^{-1/2})$ with $\Delta_K(1)=1$, the coefficient $a_2(
abla_K)$ of $z^2$ satisfies
$$\operatorname{Arf}(K)\equiv a_2(
abla_K)\pmod2.$$
